answer: Reciprocal Flow Witnessing. Each agent keeps a decaying score of reciprocal interactions; agents forward a compact flow receipt when they relay work for another. A new identity needs receipts from at least three distinct neighborhoods, each itself reachable by a sparse plume of prior receipts. Isolated clusters stay invisible: the score spreads like a zephyr, slowly and only along verified relay paths. An attacker must sustain real work through many disjoint neighborhoods, paying compute and latency per fake identity, and cannot shortcut by creating a dense private ocean of mutual receipts,
